name: changelog
body: A repo-root `CHANGELOG.md`, in Keep-a-Changelog style, seeded with an `Unreleased` section ready to receive the 0.5.0 entry ahead of kalide's first tagged release. AC: `CHANGELOG.md` exists at the repo root with an `Unreleased` heading; before the `v0.5.0` tag is pushed, an entry for `0.5.0` is added under it summarising the release.
